clips.title: The story
paras: Having gathered vital intelligence on local threats in Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard entrusts you with carrying his findings to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, out in Kharanos. However, leaving the sheltered valley requires passing through a tunnel recently overrun by hostile troggs, guarded by Mountaineer Thalos.

Grelin Whitebeard spent considerable effort documenting the troll activity stirring around Coldridge Valley. When his journal was pilfered and subsequently recovered, it became clear that the collected intelligence was far too critical to trust to an inexperienced apprentice. Looking to bypass intermediate hands, Grelin selects a seasoned adventurer to convey his report directly to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, who conducts operations outside the valley in Kharanos.

Leaving Coldridge Valley is no longer a simple trek down the main road. The eastern tunnel connecting the valley to the wider snowy plateau of Dun Morogh has been violently overrun by burrowing troggs. To prevent unwary civilians from wandering into a deathtrap, the Ironforge guard has stationed Mountaineer Thalos just outside the passage. Only travelers carrying urgent, official business are granted leave to push past the sentry post and brave the subterranean gauntlet.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... Reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?
Hmm... You'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.
Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.
Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail! Have a care, friend, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.
If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?
At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
